title: Missing runtime __getattr__
detail: The __getattr__ function is now defined only inside a TYPE_CHECKING block, so at runtime it is not defined. This causes AttributeError for attributes like __version__ and any other dynamic attributes that were previously handled by __getattr__.
note: Says __getattr__ is now defined only for type checkers, so it's missing at runtime.

title: Incorrect prefix validation logic
detail: The function incorrectly rejects non-prefixed cookies and accepts invalid __Host- cookies because the condition is inverted. It also incorrectly applies __Secure- rules to all non-__Host- cookies. This causes many valid cookies to be dropped and invalid ones to be accepted.
